breakpoints.name: hero-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: At 1200px, equal columns share upper and metadata rows through subgrid. Complete title belongs to the left upper group; title/stage tops and action/stage bottoms align. Below it, the film fills the shared stacked width.

layout.desktop: At 1200px and above, two equal columns share upper and metadata rows through subgrid; 16px row gap and 48px column gap. Complete H1, intro and actions occupy the upper left group, with title/stage top and action/stage bottom identical. Title scales 40–60px; intro scales 17–20px/1.55. Upper-group gaps are 20px and only residual space before actions flexes through an automatic margin. Prices occupy the lower left metadata row, vertically centered with the right caption and 44px-minimum playback control.
layout.stage: The film stage uses its 16:9 geometry when it fits and grows with taller text when necessary. Contain fitting preserves the entire 16:9 source with modest neutral letterboxing; no crop or stretched video.
layout.stacked: Below 1200px, visual order remains title, intro, price, actions, full shared-width film, with unchanged mobile typography.
layout.preserved: ReviewsPage.tsx groups the full unchanged H1 with intro/actions and separates price metadata; the two CSS modules implement shared rows. DE/EN copy, complete 16:9 variably paced 12-second media, models, prices, catalogue and inquiry behavior remain unchanged.
